description: President Donald Trump filed a First Amended Complaint against the same six defendants, again pleading defamation per se and defamation per quod and again demanding "not to be less than $10 billion dollars." The amended pleading adds allegations directed at the actual malice standard the Court found unmet, including that the article omitted how the defendants obtained or verified the letter, that they either withheld what Ghislaine Maxwell told them or declined to interview her, that Keith Rupert Murdoch spoke with President Trump immediately before publication and was told the letter was fake, and that the Journal's September 8, 2025 visual analysis of the letter relied on material available to the defendants at the time of publication.
headline: President Trump Files Amended Complaint in Defamation Suit Over Birthday Album Report

info.description: The defendants moved on June 10, 2026 to dismiss the amended complaint with prejudice.
info.note: Judge Darrin P. Gayles heard argument on that motion on August 5, 2026 and stayed all discovery in the matter pending his ruling. As of this entry, the motion remains undecided.
